text:
nina: Heads up — targeting tonight 22:00 UTC for coordinated deploy. runtime:v2.3, api:v1.9, console:patch. Need decision on cross-service pinning and rollback order. Can we avoid a full-stack rollback if runtime has perf regressions?

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy window confirmed: 2026-03-20 22:00 UTC. Services: runtime, api, console. Canary plan allowed. Use /deploy to start waves. 

omar: runtime will ship the KV eviction fix in v2.3. We can do a staged canary: 5% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100%. If P99 latency > +15% for >3min, automatically rollback runtime to v2.2.

jade: console has a new flag for runtime endpoint discovery (feature flag: runtime_discovery_v2). We need console pinned to older discovery until runtime reaches 50% canary, otherwise UI errors. So order: api can go first, runtime canary next, console follows at 50%.

mike: Recommend SLO thresholds as abort gates: errors > 1% OR latency +15% OR increased 5xx from router by >0.5% in 10m. If any trigger, rollback the service that caused spike and pause others. Also ensure router has pinned route variant to avoid instant full cutover.

nina: OK. Proposal: 1) api deploy to 5% (smoke), 2) runtime canary 5% then monitor, 3) at 50% runtime we flip console flag and deploy console, 4) router traffic pin stays in place until all checks pass.

omar: I will publish runtime pin label: runtime:v2.3-pinrc1 and a compatibility tag for router. Router team, make sure your route selector supports tag fallback.

deploy-bot: Example command to run waves: ` /deploy start --wave "api" --canary 5 --hold 10m ` then ` /deploy start --wave "runtime" --canary 5 --auto-step 5m ` then ` /deploy start --wave "console" --when runtime=50% `

jade: Also note: console schema change is backward compatible but we still want the flag switch. If runtime rollback happens, console must stay on old discovery.

mike: I'll add monitoring checks to the rollout runbook and a quick PagerDuty escalation if router 5xx spikes. Add this as requirement for automated progression.

nina: Good. One more: rollback ordering if things go bad — prefer rollback runtime first (most risky), then api, then console. Documenting in release notes: note pinned route values and rollback criteria.

omar: Agreed. I'll push a short README in the release PR with the pin commands and the kernel setting that changed.

deploy-bot: Deploy window updated with runbook link: https://internal.redwood/release/runbooks/1769104321 — remember to ack in the channel before 21:45 UTC.

nina: ack. I'll post the release notes and the pinned route values. :thumbsup:
